goal: Document and validate enforceable delivery and operation models for Child Mode across child-dedicated devices, shared devices with age-governed accounts, and guardian-controlled temporary use.
required_properties: child-dedicated device can be device-bound to Child Mode
shared device derives effective mode from the active authenticated age-governed account
guardian-controlled temporary Child Mode requires account-holder security reauthentication to enter or exit
mandatory age/legal restrictions cannot be weakened by an optional guardian toggle
mode changes are policy-evaluated and receipt-producing
